title: Scheduled low-degree polynomial learner
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $\ell$, and a rational parameter $\delta$ with $0<\delta\leq 1/2$, define a random-example learning program by running the low-degree $\mathbb{F}_2$ polynomial learner with the sample count prescribed by $n$, $\ell$, and $\delta$. Its output is a hypothesis assigning an $\mathbb{F}_2$ coefficient to each subset of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ of size at most $\ell$.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not include the definitions of the learner or its sample-count rule, so their precise construction cannot be stated self-containedly.
